# jdBasic

> jdBasic is a BASIC dialect with a bytecode VM, APL-style arrays and a native compiler (`jdbasic -c`, through LLVM, to a Windows .exe). Graphics, GUI (Win32 forms, ImGui, terminal UI), sound, HTTP client and server, SQLite, JSON, COM automation and local LLMs are built in. `jdbasic --mcp` is a Model Context Protocol server: an AI agent runs code in a persistent VM and can pause a running program, change a SUB and resume it. Created by Atomi JD, MIT licensed, current release line 1.2.

Facts a model needs before it writes jdBasic:

- Strings and arrays are 0-based (`arr[0]`, `MID$(s$, 0, 1)`); `INSTR` answers -1 when absent. `IOTA(5)` is `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]`; `IOTA(5, 0)` starts at 0.
- Strings have no escapes: `CHR$(10)`, `CHR$(34)`, `VBNEWLINE`, or `""` for one quote. `$"Hi {{name$}}"` interpolates.
- Blocks close with `ENDIF`, `ENDFUNC`, `ENDSUB`, `ENDTYPE`, `ENDSWITCH`, `ENDTRY`; `EXITFOR`, `EXITDO`, `EXITFUNC`, `EXITSUB`, `EXITSWITCH` leave a block early (single tokens).
- `AND`/`OR` are logical and evaluate both sides; `ANDALSO`/`ORELSE` short-circuit; bitwise is `BAND`, `BOR`, `BXOR`, `SHL`, `SHR`.
- `APPEND` is a function (`a = APPEND(a, v)`); `SELECT(fn@, arr)` maps, `FILTER`, `REDUCE`, `LAMBDA x -> x * 2`; `MAP` is the dictionary type, indexed `m{"key"}`.
- `MAX`, `MIN`, `SUM`, `MEAN` reduce one array: `MAX([a, b])`. Constants are `MATH.PI` and `MATH.E`. Timing is `TICK()` in milliseconds.
- Absence: `x = NONE` is also true for `0` and `""`; test `TYPEOF(x) = "NONE"` or use `x ?? default`. `TYPEOF` of a map is `"OBJECT"`, of numbers `"INT64"` / `"FLOAT64"`.
- A SUB or FUNC writes a global only if that global already exists; otherwise it creates a local. Builtin names are reserved as identifiers, case-insensitively.
- `jdbasic -c` always applies STRICT and EXPLICIT: declare every variable (`DIM total AS INTEGER = 0`).
- When unsure whether a builtin exists, check `HELP "NAME"`, the language reference, or the MCP tool `jdb_doc`. A name found in none of them does not exist.

## Start here

- [jdBasic for language models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/llms-primer.md): what jdBasic is, the rules models get wrong, the syntax with tested examples, the MCP server
- [Full documentation in one file](https://www.jdbasic.org/llms-full.txt): the primer, tour, guides, MCP reference, module library, full language reference and HELP text, about 790 KB
- [A tour of jdBasic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/tour.md): from the first PRINT to a compiled .exe in fifteen minutes; every example is CI-checked
- [Name changes in 1.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/name-changes.md): the names that changed in the 1.2 refresh (a name ends in $ exactly when it answers a string, lower-case keys in builtin maps, handlers as funcrefs, degrees for graphics) and tools/jdb-fix.jdb, which rewrites old code
- [Idioms from Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/idioms-from-python.md): Python-to-jdBasic cheat sheet with the gotchas

## Reference

- [Language reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/languages.md): every statement, operator and builtin, with an A-Z index
- [Builtin HELP text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/help.txt): syntax and description of every builtin, as `HELP "NAME"` prints it
- [Module library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/lib/README.md): 45 importable modules (TESTKIT, JDWEB, TMPL, data frames, SQLite, XLSX, DOCX, PDF, QR, YAML)

## AI agents and MCP

- [The MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/MCP.md): setup for Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Zed and others; the tools jdb_eval, jdb_check, jdb_doc, jdb_stop, jdb_recompile, jdb_resume and more, all on one persistent VM
- [Programming with an AI agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/guides/ai-mcp.md): live patching a running program over MCP; local LLMs, RAG and ONNX inside jdBasic

## Guides

- [Compiling to a native .exe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/guides/native.md): STRICT and EXPLICIT, type annotations, what stays interpreter-only
- [Working with data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/guides/data.md): CSV, JSON, grouping, dates, reports
- [From loops to array pipelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/APL_pipeline.md): APL-style whole-array programming
- [Vectors, matrices and data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/howto-vector-matrix-data.md): cookbook
- [Graphics and games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/guides/graphics-games.md): window, game loop, sprites, tile maps, sound
- [Desktop applications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/guides/gui.md): native Windows forms, Dear ImGui, terminal UI
- [Web development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/WebDev.md): HTTP server, JDWEB, templates, cookie login, SQLite
- [jdBasic on a microcontroller](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AtomiJD/jdBasic/main/doc/guides/boards.md): RP2350 (PicoCalc) and ESP32-S3
